sentinels.model_note: the model id the Claude Code CLI reported for each review (its modelUsage), with the call date; "not recorded" for reviews answered before exoplan stored it (the cache key holds only "default")

notes: Each star's first two SPOC 2-minute sectors (the live feed reviews the latest two); a star with one sector cannot pass the two-sector rule and counts as one target.

Discovery config: subject-mode BLS, the three Probes with the feed's weights file. Fit and TIC stellar parameters off, because admission never reads them; docs/results/feed_rule_stellar_check.json shows identical admission inputs with them on, on a seeded 20-star subsample.

A worker restart stopped the first held-out run at 120 of 345 stars before it wrote anything; the script then gained a per-star store so the run resumes (the rule and the scoring are unchanged), and the run was restarted. The trials already computed were reused from their cache.

preregistration.objective: Among the grid's rules whose worse control gives at most 1 false signals per 100 targets on the tuning half, the one with the highest tuning completeness (ties: the tighter period tolerance, then the depth check, then no aliases); if none meets it, the lowest noise.
preregistration.held_out_plan: Evaluated once on the held-out half: completeness, FP rejection and false signals per 100 targets on both controls, old rule against the chosen rule. The fix is claimed only if the worse control's held-out noise rate under the chosen rule is below the old rule's with non-overlapping Wilson 95% intervals; otherwise the report says it is not shown to work.

live.rule: two-sector rule, FAP < 0.001 over 2,000 trials (pre-registered 8909cda; held-out validation docs/results/feed_rule_validation.json)
